    14	# Sheafification
    15	
    16	Given a site `(C, J)` we define a typeclass `HasSheafify J A` saying that the inclusion functor from
    17	`A`-valued sheaves on `C` to presheaves admits a left exact left adjoint (sheafification).
    18	
    19	Note: to access the `HasSheafify` instance for suitable concrete categories, import the file
    20	`Mathlib/CategoryTheory/Sites/LeftExact.lean`.

    34	/--
    35	A proposition saying that the inclusion functor from sheaves to presheaves admits a left adjoint.
    36	-/
    37	abbrev HasWeakSheafify : Prop := (sheafToPresheaf J A).IsRightAdjoint
    38	
    39	/--
    40	`HasSheafify` means that the inclusion functor from sheaves to presheaves admits a left exact
    41	left adjoint (sheafification).
    42	
    43	Given a functor, preserving finite limits, `F : (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ⥤ Sheaf J A` and an adjunction
    44	`adj : F ⊣ sheafToPresheaf J A`, use `HasSheafify.mk'` to construct a `HasSheafify` instance.
    45	-/
    46	class HasSheafify : Prop where
    47	  isRightAdjoint : HasWeakSheafify J A
    48	  isLeftExact : PreservesFiniteLimits ((sheafToPresheaf J A).leftAdjoint)
    49	
    50	instance [HasSheafify J A] : HasWeakSheafify J A := HasSheafify.isRightAdjoint
    51	
    52	noncomputable section
    53	
    54	instance [HasSheafify J A] : PreservesFiniteLimits ((sheafToPresheaf J A).leftAdjoint) :=
    55	  HasSheafify.isLeftExact
    56	
    57	theorem HasSheafify.mk' {F : (Cᵒᵖ ⥤ A) ⥤ Sheaf J A} (adj : F ⊣ sheafToPresheaf J A)
    58	    [PreservesFiniteLimits F] : HasSheafify J A where
    59	  isRightAdjoint := ⟨F, ⟨adj⟩⟩
    60	  isLeftExact := ⟨by
    61	    have : (sheafToPresheaf J A).IsRightAdjoint := ⟨_, ⟨adj⟩⟩
    62	    exact fun _ _ _ ↦ preservesLimitsOfShape_of_natIso
    63	      (adj.leftAdjointUniq (Adjunction.ofIsRightAdjoint (sheafToPresheaf J A)))⟩
    64	
    65	instance : HasSheafify (⊥ : GrothendieckTopology C) A :=

    74	  (sheafToPresheaf J A).leftAdjoint

import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0AdmissibleAbelEtaleSheafification
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.Pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf

/-!
# Comparing raw Pic0 Sigma with its big-etale sheafification

The raw Pic0 Sigma functor is already a sheaf for the big-etale topology. After the
universe lift required by the Scheme site, the sheafification unit is therefore an
isomorphism. This file bundles that sheaf and records the canonical comparison used by
the quotient-Yoneda step.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Opposite

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

noncomputable section

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (.of k)))
variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
variable [GeometricallyIrreducible C.hom] [GeometricallyReduced C.hom]

/-- The universe-raised raw Pic0 Sigma presheaf is a big-etale sheaf. -/
theorem pic0SigmaFunctor_ulift_presheafIsSheaf_etale :
    Presheaf.IsSheaf Scheme.etaleTopology
      (pic0SigmaFunctor C ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1}) :=
  (isSheaf_iff_isSheaf_of_type _ _).mpr
    (Presieve.isSheaf_comp_uliftFunctor Scheme.etaleTopology
      (pic0SigmaFunctor_isSheaf_etale C))

/-- The universe-raised raw Pic0 Sigma functor bundled as a big-etale sheaf. -/
noncomputable def pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf :
    Sheaf Scheme.etaleTopology.{u} (Type (u + 1)) :=
  ⟨pic0SigmaFunctor C ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1},
    pic0SigmaFunctor_ulift_presheafIsSheaf_etale C⟩

/-- The natural isomorphism from universe-raised raw Pic0 Sigma to the underlying
presheaf of the sheafification used as the admissible Abel target. -/
noncomputable def pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso :
    (pic0SigmaFunctor C ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1}) ≅
      (pic0SigmaEtaleSheafification C).obj :=
  isoSheafify Scheme.etaleTopology
    (pic0SigmaFunctor_ulift_presheafIsSheaf_etale C)

/-- The same canonical comparison bundled in the category of big-etale sheaves. -/
noncomputable def pic0SigmaEtaleSheafIso :
    pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf C ≅ pic0SigmaEtaleSheafification C :=
  sheafificationIso (pic0SigmaEtaleSheaf C)

/-- The underlying hom of the comparison is exactly the sheafification unit. -/
@[simp]
theorem pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso_hom :
    (pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso C).hom =
      toSheafify Scheme.etaleTopology
        (pic0SigmaFunctor C ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1}) :=
  rfl

/-- The bundled and unbundled comparisons have the same underlying natural map. -/
@[simp]
theorem pic0SigmaEtaleSheafIso_hom :
    (pic0SigmaEtaleSheafIso C).hom.hom =
      (pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso C).hom :=
  rfl

/-- Component form of the canonical-map identification. -/
@[simp]
theorem pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso_hom_app (T : Scheme.{u}ᵒᵖ) :
    (pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso C).hom.app T =
      (toSheafify Scheme.etaleTopology
        (pic0SigmaFunctor C ⋙ uliftFunctor.{u + 1})).app T := by
  rw [pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationIso_hom]

end

end AlgebraicGeometry

/bin/bash -lc 'set -u
lock=/tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks/lake.lock
target=AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationComparison.lean
mkdir -p /tmp/claude-1001/ajcr-locks
if ! mkdir "$lock" 2>/dev/null; then
  printf '"'mutex busy: '
  if [ -f \""'$lock/pid" ]; then
    sed -n '"'1p' \""'$lock/pid"
  else
    printf '"'owner unknown\\n'
  fi
  exit 75
fi
owner="'$$
printf '"'%s\\n' \""'$owner" > "$lock/pid"
cleanup() {
  if [ -f "$lock/pid" ] && [ "$(sed -n '"'1p' \""'$lock/pid")" = "$owner" ]; then
    unlink "$lock/pid"
    rmdir "$lock"
  fi
}
trap cleanup EXIT INT TERM
read -r before_hash _ < <(sha256sum "$target")
before_mtime=$(stat -c %Y "$target")
printf '"'owner=%s before_hash=%s before_mtime=%s\\n' \""'$owner" "$before_hash" "$before_mtime"
lake env lean "$target"
lean_status=$?
read -r after_hash _ < <(sha256sum "$target")
after_mtime=$(stat -c %Y "$target")
printf '"'lean_status=%s after_hash=%s after_mtime=%s\\n' \""'$lean_status" "$after_hash" "$after_mtime"
if [ "$before_hash" != "$after_hash" ] || [ "$before_mtime" != "$after_mtime" ]; then
  printf '"'source changed during verification\\n'
  exit 74
fi
exit \""'$lean_status"'

path=AlgebraicJacobian/Picard/Pic0SigmaEtaleSheafificationComparison.lean

cleanup_index() {
  if [ -e "$idx" ]; then
    unlink "$idx"
  fi
}
trap cleanup_index EXIT INT TERM
ref=$("$HORIZON_GIT" symbolic-ref -q HEAD)
old=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse HEAD)
GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" read-tree "$old"

printf '"'private-index paths:\\n'
GIT_INDEX_FILE=\""'$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" diff --cached --name-status
tree=$(GIT_INDEX_FILE="$idx" "$HORIZON_GIT" write-tree)
commit=$("$HORIZON_GIT" commit-tree "$tree" -p "$old" -m "feat(picard): identify raw Pic0 with etale sheafification" -m "Bundle the universe-lifted raw Pic0 functor as a big-etale sheaf and identify its sheafification unit with a canonical natural isomorphism.")
if ! "$HORIZON_GIT" update-ref "$ref" "$commit" "$old"; then
  printf '"'HEAD moved during commit; no ref updated\\n'
  exit 73
fi
printf 'old=%s\\ncommit=%s\\n' \""'$old" "$commit"
"$HORIZON_GIT" show --stat --oneline --summary "$commit"'
